title: Rewrite add_member_screen.dart to new design system
validation: All string literals use double quotes
Cubit constructor signature unchanged - AddMemberCubit(membersRepository, carnivalBlockMembersRepository)
Screen widget class name `AddMemberScreen` and constructor `const AddMemberScreen({super.key, required this.carnivalBlockId})` preserved (carnivalBlockId is required)
NO emojis as icons - Material Symbols Rounded only
AppSearchField is at the top of the body with onChanged wiring cubit.search(query)
List renders MemberCard per filtered member with AppIconButton (Icons.person_add_rounded) as trailing
Bottom AppButton shows selection count in label (e.g. 'Adicionar (N)')
On add success: AppSnackbar.success then context.pop()
On add failure: AppSnackbar.error with user-friendly pt-BR message
